newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts eye upside while 115-02 holds.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts eye upside while 115-02 holds.

text.p: September gilt futures on LIFFE will stay confined in a firm range on Monday but the outlook remains bullish while key 115-02 support holds, analysts said.
Daily technicals, including stochastics, RSI and moving averages, still favour the upside, but the market may not have the stamina to overcome the contract high of 115-25 yet.
"The market is still bullish if it can stay above 115-02," said Lynn Branigan, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch, adding that mild support intervened at 115-07, the low on July 23.
At 0700 GMT, the September gilt contract opened 7/32 down on the day at 115-12. The low on Friday was 115-02.

Branigan said while above 115-02, which is also the top of the previous lower range, gilts could challenge the contract high, which would then pave the way for 116-00 initially, followed by the Fibonacci projection of 116-13.
But he said the market was more likely to stay within tbe current range.

On the downside, if 115-02 faltered, the contract would initially target 114-25, a congestion level, then 114-11 which was the low on July 21. Trendline support came in at 114-15, Branigan said, adding that 114-11 should hold.
Juliette Clark, senior treasury manager at the Royal Bank of Scotland, said in a reseach note there was a potential for a triple top on the daily chart.
"Stay neutral for the moment. But should a drift start then be prepared to sell," Clark said.

The first level to watch was 115-13, with a narrow trading range around here set at 115-10 and 115-17. If 115-10 support failed, the contract could drift to 115-05. A bear move would be confirmed below there, with a stab at 114-31 and 114-24.
"Take profits from shorts here. A swing higher will follow over the next couple of days," she said.
But that swing should fail at 115-13/15, she added.
On the upside, a break above 115-17 would leave September within striking distance of 115-23/25, then the bulls would be back on track, eyeing 116-01, 116-07, then 116-21.
December short sterling was quoted 0.01 down on the day at 92.63.
